gloss.intro: Ny goan ta ymmydeyryn (as ny possanyn AI) ymmyd jeu, ayns goan soilshey.
gloss.switch.help: Ta goan lesh pwoaltyn feddyn mínit soilshey tra ta oo cur y moose harrish ad.
gloss.backlog.text: Smooinaghtyn as obbyr nagh vel planit foddey. Cha vel red erbee ayns shen gobbraghey er derrey t'eh gleashtyn gys Dy yannoo.
gloss.sprint.text: Traa giare jeh obbyr (dy cadjin shiaghtin ny daa) lesh set cordit jeh carteyn dy yannoo.
gloss.standup.text: Jeeaghyn tappee: cre ren dy chooilley fer-lhiasee, cre nee eh ec heet, as cre ta e lhiettal.
gloss.bug.text: Red nagh vel gobbraghey myr lhisagh eh.
gloss.test.text: Prowal obbyr jeant dy yeeaghyn dy vel eh jannoo cre va fenneyt, roish y ghymmyrkey.
gloss.commit.text: Dealbh sauailt jeh'n coad, lesh cooish ghiare jeh cre ren caghlaa. Foddee oo goll er ash gys unnane dy kinjagh.
gloss.push.text: Cur dealbyn sauailt (commits) veih'n co-earrooder shoh gys GitHub, dy vel ad cooillit as rheynnit.
gloss.branch.text: Linney scarrit jeh obbyr ayns y choad, dy vod caghlaaghyn ve jeant gyn tayrn er y lhieggan s'mie.
gloss.merge.text: Cur caghlaaghyn branch gys y lhieggan s'mie reesht.
gloss.repo.text: Pillagh coad y phryjeck as e hennaghys slane jeh commits, dy cadjin freayllit er GitHub myrgeddin.
gloss.refactor.text: Glenney y choad gyn caghlaa cre ta eh jannoo: coadanyn s'veggey, ennymyn s'soilshey, sloo ashoonaghey.
gloss.deploy.text: Cur lhieggan vree bio, y.e. er servaneyder raad ta pobble ymmyd jeh.
gloss.kanban.text: Bord lesh colbaghyn (Dy yannoo, Ayns obbyr, Jeant) raad ta carteyn goll veih çheerey gys yesh myr ta obbyr tashtey.
gloss.wip.text: Obbyr ayns obbyr: y keim smoo jeh carteyn lhisagh colbagh ve ayn, dy vel y possan jeantagh reddyn roish toshiaghtyn smoo.
gloss.pr.text: Fenney dy vel caghlaaghyn branch jeeaghit as cur gys y lhieggan s'mie.
gloss.hook.text: Harey veg ta roie hene ec traa soit, y.e. tra ta shesheen AI toshiaghtyn, dy vel y possan clashtyn dty ghaghlinyn.
gloss.token.text: Yn unnaid ta ymmyd AI earroo ayn: mysh paart ynnydyn jeh teks lhaihit ny scruit. Sloo tokens, smoo jeh dty phlan faagit.
gloss.agent.text: AI ta gobbraghey er-hene er obbyr: lhaih y choad, jannoo caghlaaghyn, roie jeeaghyn, as cur fys er ash.

tour.intro: Paart stadyn mygeayrt y bord. Cre cha mooar t'ou gearree?

tour.welcome.title: Failt ort gys AI-gile
tour.welcome.text: Bord raad ta possanyn AI jannoo yn obbyr as t'ou shassoo, prowal as gymmyrkey. Shoh kys dy gheddyn dty raad.
tour.welcome.why: Y smooinaght: ta ny possanyn jannoo yn obbyr treih, as ta oo fakin agh cre ta feme dhooinney.
tour.rail.title: Dty phryjeckyn
tour.rail.text: Thie, dty phost-stiagh, taggloo lesh ny leeideilee, eisht un merk son dy chooilley phryjeck. Ta diamant purple jeheet red ayns shen ec feitt er dty hon. Tayrn ny merkyn dy chur ad ayns dty ordagh.
tour.rail.short: Pryjeckyn ayns y raaid (cheu woaile er fon); ta diamondyn purple soilshaghey ta nhee ec feitt dhyts.
tour.rail.why: Ta un jeeaghyn gra dhyts raad ta feme ort, gyn foshil red erbee.
tour.inbox.title: Dty phost-stiagh
tour.inbox.text: Dy chooilley red ec feitt er dty hon, trooid dy chooilley phryjeck: fennyn, obbraghyn nagh vod agh oo yannoo, as reddyn dy phrowal. Cliklee chip dy yeeaghyn yn sorçh shen ny-lomarcan.
tour.inbox.short: Ooilley ta ec feitt er dty hon, dy chooilley raad. Cliklee chip son un sorçh.
tour.inbox.why: Cha lhisagh oo goll dy chooilley phryjeck dy hennaghey cre ta feme ort.
tour.foryou.title: Dhyts
tour.foryou.text: Er bord, ta'n colbagh shoh freayll cre ta ec feitt er dty hon ayns y phryjeck shen. Foshil prowal, geiyrt rish e chemmeeyn, eisht Gymmyrkey ny Cur er ash lesh resoon.
tour.foryou.short: Grian y phryjeck shoh dhyts: prowal, eisht Gymmyrkey ny Cur er ash.
tour.foryou.why: Cha vel possanyn cummey nyn obbyr hene jeant: ta oo gymmyrkey eh. Shen freayll yn cairys ayns dty laue.
tour.chat.title: Taggloo lesh ny leeideilee
tour.chat.text: Screeu gys leeideilagh pryjeck lesh smooinaght ny henney. Ta ad caghlaa smooinaghtyn gys carteyn as plan giare, lesh cliquoinyn Gow dhyts.
tour.chat.short: Screeu gys leeideilagh; ta eh planney as ta oo cliklee Gow.
tour.chat.why: Cha vel red erbee troggit derrey ta oo gra gow: t'ou fer-chiarail jeh cre ta tashtey.
tour.setup.title: Soiaghyn
tour.setup.text: Dty ennym, chengey, tuarastyl as raad ta'n AI bio er y co-earrooder shoh. Ta cliquoin myrgeddin dy hinsh goan y ymmydeyryn, as y ghoan-lioar.
tour.setup.short: Dty hoiaghyn, chengey as lioar-ghlossary dev-focklyn. Er fon ta eh fo'n menu er y vullagh.

gloss.about.noai: Ny goan ver oo er ayns AI-gile, ayns goan soilshey: troggal eh, caghlaa eh dy sauchey, freayll eh goll son y pobble ta jannoo ymmyd jeh, as gobbraghey myr possan.
gloss.qa.text: Giarrey son quality assurance: ny prowallyn hene-obbragh ta roie roish ta red erbee goll bio. Tra ta QA jiarg, ta red ennagh er failleil, as cha vod eh goll bio derrey ta shen jeshit.
gloss.release.text: Bundel enmyssit jeh obbyr jeant ta goll bio cooidjagh, lesh notaghyn giare er ny va caghlaait. Ta 🚀 Releases screeu ny notaghyn veih ny carteyn jeant.
gloss.rollback.text: Goll er ash gys y lhieggan s’jerree va gobbraghey tra ta lhieggan noa jannoo trubbyl. Ayns AI-gile, t’eh jannoo rolley-prowal jeh ny kesmadyn dy chur er ash, screeuit er dagh caghlaa.
gloss.live.text: Y lhieggan feer ta pobble jannoo ymmyd jeh, cha nee coip son prowal reddyn. Ta ymmydeyryn gra production rish myrgeddin.
gloss.change.text: Caghlaa kiartit er red ennagh ta pobble croghey er, screeuit sheese hoshiaght: cre, cre’n fa, y danjeyr, cuin, as kys dy chur er ash eh. Toshee fer lesh 🔀 Troggal caghlaa.
gloss.risk.text: Red ennagh oddagh goll rish shaghryn, lesh scoar er cho lhisagh eh taghyrt as cho olk as veagh eh. Ta ⚠️ Kione-chiaraillyn freayll ad ayns un rolley, y scoar syrjey hoshiaght, dagh fer lesh date dy yeeaghyn reesht.
gloss.chgwin.text: Ny traaghyn tra oddys caghlaaghyn goll bio, myr fastyr Jemayrt quiee. Mooie jeh finnag cha nod cart caghlaa ve jeant, mannagh nee eigin t’ayn.
gloss.gonogo.text: Vot tappee roish ta caghlaa goll bio: ta dagh peiagh ta feme echey gymmyrkey gra Go ny No go. Cha jed eh er y hoshiaght agh tra t’ad ooilley coardail.
gloss.approval.text: Fieau son “ta” roish ta’n obbyr toshiaght. Ta cart ta carrey troggal, ny caghlaa, fieau ayns ✅ Gymmyrkaghyn derrey t’ou gymmyrkey ny obbal eh.
gloss.quiettime.text: Tammylt dy hraa, myr stream, demo ny yn oie, tra nagh vel red erbee goll bio. Ta ny possanyn freayll orrin gobbraghey as prowal, agh ta goll bio fieau derrey t’eh harrish. Ayns boayllyn elley t’eh enmyssit change freeze.
gloss.service.text: Red ennagh hrog oo ta pobble croghey er, myr ynnyd-eggey ny app, kiarail jeh dy vel eh freayll er gobbraghey. Cur kaart er “Ta’n pryjeck shoh service” as insh cre t’eh chebbal, quoi ta jannoo ymmyd jeh as quoi ta on-call.
gloss.uptime.text: Prowal hene-obbragh, dagh shiartanse dy vinnidyn, dy vel dty service foast freggyrt. My t’eh failleil keayrtyn ny lurg y cheilley, ta AI-gile fosley cart incident er e hon hene.
gloss.statuspage.text: Duillag phublick ta soilshaghey vel service gobbraghey (glass, oranse ny jiarg) lesh y naight s’noa, son dy vod y pobble ta jannoo ymmyd jeh jeeaghyn ayns ynnyd dy vriaght.
gloss.incident.text: Red ennagh ta brisht son y pobble ta jannoo ymmyd jeh nish, myr yn ynnyd-eggey ve sheese. Ta cart 🔥 incident lheimyragh roish y tidey: t’eh y chied red dy gheddyn eh gobbraghey reesht.
gloss.major.text: Incident feer vooar: ymmodee pobble jeh, ny argid ny fysseree ayns danjeyr. Ta un chramman cur dagh possan er (swarm), doostey quoi erbee ta on-call as briaght son naight status dagh 30 minnid.
gloss.oncall.text: Ve yn fer ta freggyrt tra ta red ennagh brishey, eer ec yn oie. Ta oltey possan on-call ec dagh service ta doostit hoshiaght son ny incidents echey.
gloss.replyby.text: Cre cho liauyr as oddys cart fieau son y chied freggyrt, myr shampleyr oor son incident. Lurg shen ta clag jiarg echey, son nagh bee red erbee jarroodit dy kiune. T’eh enmyssit response target myrgeddin.
gloss.postmortem.text: Jeeagh giare er ash lurg incident: cre haghyr, cre ren cooney as cre lhisagh caghlaa, gyn cur y oghsan er peiagh erbee. Cha nod incident ve dooint fegooish fer.
gloss.problem.text: Y chooish follit cooyl jeh un incident ny ny smoo. Ta cart 🧩 doilleeid chaglym incidents ta cheet er ash dy kinjagh, son dy bee y chooish feddynit as jeshit son dy bragh.
gloss.rootcause.text: Yn oyr feer ren red ennagh brishey, cha nee agh ny honnick oo goll rish shaghryn. Jesh y vun-chooish as cha jig yn incident er ash.
gloss.workaround.text: Aght dy reayll reddyn gobbraghey derrey ta’n jesheenys feer aarloo, myr cur red ennagh er reesht tra t’eh lhiantyn. T’eh screeuit er y chart doilleeid son nagh bee orrin peiagh erbee dy obbraghey magh eh reesht.
gloss.knownerror.text: Doilleeid ta’n chooish eck toiggit as ta workaround eck, agh nagh vel jeshit foast. Ta 🧩 Ny jantyn enney cur rolley jeu, son dy jean dy chooilley pheiagh ymmyd jeh’n workaround ayns ynnyd dy chleiy reesht.
gloss.runbook.text: Saraghyn kesmad er kesmad son jeshaghey sorch trubbyl enney, son dy bee eh jeant yn aght cheddin, dy tappee, dagh keayrt. Lurg incident mooar, foddee yn possan fer y chur seose dhyt son OK.
gloss.backup.text: Coip sauailt jeh dty fysseree veih roie, dy huittym er ash er my ta red ennagh caillit ny jeeghit. Ta AI-gile jannoo coip-sauchys jeh dty voardyn dagh laa.
gloss.restore.text: Cur fysseree er ash veih coip-sauchys. Cha nel coip-sauchys coontey dy feer derrey ta fys ayd dy vod eh ve aahoit, myr shen t’eh feeu prowal eh nish as reesht.
gloss.dod.also: Definition of Done,Mychione Aarloo,Definition of Ready
gloss.dod.text: Rolley-prowal giare y phossan er cre ta “jeant” cur bun, myr prowit as mynit, roish ta cart currit dhyt. Ta’n lhiannoo-daa echey, Mychione Aarloo, gra cuin ta cart soilshey dy liooar dy hoshiaght.
gloss.testpile.text: Ny carteyn jeant ta fieau ort dy phrowal, fer lurg fer. Gymmyrkey fer ny cur er ash eh lesh note, as ta’n nah fer cheet seose.
gloss.retro.text: Jeeagh er ash er kys ta’n possan gobbraghey, dy choardail er un red dy yannoo ny share. Ayns AI-gile, ta retro cur caghlaa roish er aghtyn-obbyr y phossan, as t’ou gra Go ny Cha nee nish.
gloss.peerreview.text: Jees elley dy hooillyn: ta AI elley prowal obbyr dagh cart roish t’eh roshtyn ort, son dy jig ny sloo dy hranlaasyn trooid.
gloss.swarm.text: Dy chooilley laue er y dekk: ta dagh possan faagail obbyr elley dy chooney lesh un phryjeck jeeragh derrey t’eh reaghit. Ta pryjeckyn elley fieau ’sy traa cheddin.
gloss.scrummaster.text: Yn fer ta freayll yn obbyr roie: t’eh fakin carteyn lhiantyn, greinnaghey ny possanyn as cur ayns cooinaghtyn dhyt cre ta fieau. Ayns AI-gile, ta’n Leeideilagh Scrum Mainshter jannoo shoh ayns dy chooilley phryjeck.
gloss.scrummaster.text.noai: Yn fer ta freayll yn obbyr roie: t’eh fakin carteyn lhiantyn as cur ayns cooinaghtyn dhyt cre ta fieau. Fegooish AI t’eh gobbraghey lesh saraghyn kiartit, myr reaghey Dy yannoo.
tour.firststeps.title: Ny chied kesmadyn
tour.firststeps.text: Rolley giare dy gholl er: jean pryjeck, cur cart stiagh, cuir cuirrey da carrey. Ta dagh fer cowrit eh hene tra t'ou dy yannoo eh. Follee eh tra t'ou toiggal dty raad.
tour.firststeps.short: Kuse dy reddyn dy yannoo hoshiaght. T'ad cowrit ad hene.
tour.firststeps.why: Dy yannoo dagh fer un cheayrt, shen yn aght s'tappee dy ynsaghey yn boayrd.
tour.help.title: Cooney tra t'eh feme ort
tour.help.text: ❓ Ayns Cooney ta Goaill toshiaght, yn turrys shoh reesht as y 📖 ghoan-lioar, ta mynney goan ny keirdey ayns Gaelg aashagh. Jean pryjeck ny cur cart stiagh dy gholl er.
tour.help.short: ❓ Cooney: Goaill toshiaght, yn turrys reesht as y 📖 ghoan-lioar.
tour.chat.text.noai: Loayr rish dty chaarjyn ayns shoh. Foshil taggloo carrey dy eam er, lesh feeshan as rannee screen.
tour.chat.short.noai: Taggloo lesh caarjyn. Eam er fer veih e haggloo.
tour.chat.why.noai: Loayr mychione reddyn ec cheu yn obbyr, gyn app elley.
